synthesis.body: A hand-rolled test certificate that verified on earlier versions now fails against ssl.create_default_context(). The CA needs subjectKeyIdentifier, basicConstraints CA:TRUE and keyUsage keyCertSign; the leaf needs authorityKeyIdentifier. Generate them with openssl req -addext and an -extfile. Symptoms mimic the bug under test: a missing leaf AKI reports Missing Authority Key Identifier, and a CA without SKI reports unable to get local issuer certificate, which reads exactly like a genuine trust failure.
